seo-expert-witness.intro: Need an SEO expert witness who can explain complex search engine optimization issues clearly and credibly? We provide expert witness services, litigation support, and expert testimony for cases involving search engines, website traffic, and digital marketing.

children.text: If you’re looking for an SEO expert witness to support a dispute, litigation, or investigation, you’re in the right place. We provide clear, defensible analysis and expert witness testimony on search engine optimization, website performance, and digital marketing practices.

From ranking loss and website traffic disputes to claims involving trademark infringement, online advertising, or online defamation, we help attorneys and clients understand what happened, what the data supports, and how search engines factor into the case.
Retain an SEO Expert Witness

Search engine optimization is technical, fast-changing, and easy to misunderstand in legal cases. Retaining an experienced seo expert can help clarify what is measurable, what is speculative, and what conclusions are supported by evidence.

We work with counsel to provide litigation support, documentation, and analysis that aligns with the facts of the case. When needed, we also provide expert testimony and support preparation for deposition and trial.
SEO Expert Witness Analysis

Our search engine optimization work focuses on forensic-style review and explanation. Depending on the matter, analysis may include historical visibility changes, on-site and technical SEO factors, off-site signals, and competitive context.

We can evaluate changes connected to search engine optimization seo work (on-page, technical, content, and link-related), and explain how those factors may correlate with changes in website traffic and lead volume—without overreaching past what the data can prove.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.message: Strong expert witness work is evidence-first. Preserve analytics, ad accounts, and website change history early so your SEO expert witness can map timelines and separate correlation from causation.

children.text: Digital Marketing & Internet Marketing Review

Many disputes aren’t strictly “SEO only.” We review the broader digital marketing and internet marketing ecosystem that can influence performance, including online advertising, tracking configuration, and attribution.

We frequently analyze data from google analytics, Google Search Console, server logs, and other web analytics sources to determine what changed, when it changed, and how it relates to business outcomes.
Online Advertising, Google Ads, and Attribution

Paid media can significantly impact traffic and lead generation, and it can also confuse causation in SEO-related claims. We review online advertising performance and account structure to understand whether changes in google ads may explain shifts that appear “SEO-related” at first glance.
When relevant, we can assess tracking and reporting integrity (conversion events, UTM parameters, attribution settings) and how that impacts damages arguments or performance claims.
Trademark Infringement, Domain Names, and Search Visibility

Cases involving trademark infringement or confusingly similar domain names often include questions about consumer confusion, search behavior, and whether specific marketing actions influenced search results. We help counsel evaluate what search engines display, how users may encounter content, and what can be validated with data.
We also assist with analysis of organic search presence and messaging across web pages, social media, and other online properties that may be relevant to the dispute.
Online Defamation and Online Reputation Management

When cases involve online defamation or online reputation management, search results and brand queries can become a major battleground. We can document SERP conditions, evaluate content visibility, and explain search engine behaviors that affect discovery and amplification.
We also review the role of social media marketing and online marketing distribution when it’s relevant to how content spread and how it was found.
E Commerce and Website Performance Disputes

For e commerce matters, search engine optimization intersects with product feeds, site architecture, indexing, and conversion tracking. We review technical and content factors that influence category and product visibility, and we connect those factors to measurable outcomes where possible.
When appropriate, we can provide consulting services related to remediation planning while maintaining the integrity of ongoing legal cases.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.message: In cases involving search engines, timelines matter. A clean timeline of deployments, content edits, redirects, platform changes, and marketing strategy shifts is often the difference between a strong and weak expert opinion.
